fixture_notice: All entities and observations in this packet are fictional and locally constructed.
starting_point: Find a high-impact research direction for helping on-call engineers retrieve the smallest useful set of past incident tickets, ownership clues, and decisions when an active incident begins.
current_system: Keyword search over ticket titles and comments followed by an always-on cross-encoder reranker. Results are filtered using ticket-level access labels before display.
decision_context: The team must choose one two-week offline pilot. Improving same-team average recall alone is not enough: cross-team unblocker discovery, permission safety, response time, and operator trust all matter.
decision_questions: Which failure boundary is both important and tractable with the available packet?
What new capability or combination changes what can be tested now?
Which proposal remains useful after privacy, latency, and simplicity objections?
